items.title: Principal Financial Group (PFG) Q3 Earnings Power Through Asset Outflows
items.summary: Principal Financial Group walked into this Q3 2026 earnings release with a relatively flat trading backdrop. The stock is roughly unchanged today, up about 0.04% around US$112, after a slightly weaker 30 day run. On the surface that looks like a shrug. The headline tells a different story. Principal posted Q3 basic earnings per share of about US$2.95 on revenue of roughly US$4.6b, and trailing 12 month earnings are materially higher than a year ago.
